$comment: Accepted-risk register for the Semgrep SAST gate.
Every entry here is a REAL finding that is knowingly not fixed yet. Nothing is
hidden: the gate prints this whole register into the job summary on every run,
and any finding NOT listed here fails the build. Entries match on (rule, path)
pairs only, so a listed file is still fully scanned by every other rule.
To retire an entry: fix the finding, then delete the entry. The gate warns when
a listed finding no longer reproduces, so stale entries surface on their own.
Do not add an entry to silence a finding you introduced. Fix it.
